title.narrative: FINANCE AND TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER CENTRE FOR CLIMATE CHANGE (FINTECC) - EU4CLIMATE window

description.narrative: The project combines EBRD's lending and EU's grant resources to support advanced climate financing for SMEs and mid-caps in EaP countries. EU contribution of EUR 15 million will be used for: (i)Investments in best-in-class and advanced climate technologies, innovation and circular economy measures - EUR 11 500 000; (ii) Technical assistance accompanying the investments EUR 1 400 000; (iii) Climate Innovation Voucher schemes EUR 2 000 000; and (iv) communication EUR 100 000.
